integrity: Exact finite enumeration, matching acyclicity, and Morse-cell count are reproducible with the embedded self-contained checker; an independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Specific to H(3,3) at scale two. No uniform result for arbitrary Hamming parameters, no equivariant decomposition, and no claim of exhaustive literature coverage.
title: The radius-one Čech complex of the ternary three-cube is a wedge of 134 two-spheres
